messages:
maria.ops: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off ingest for nebula-8b (community release). Need a quick sanity check on weights path + licensing before we flip to any serving configs. CC @raj.mlinfra @lee.token :wave:

raj.mlinfra: weights live at s3://redwood-models/ingest/nebula-8b/v1/weights.tar.gz (sha256: 9f8b1d2e...). Please confirm we should import from that path — it's already staged in the ingest bucket.

lee.token: noted about weights. Also heads-up: nebula-8b uses a slightly different tokenizer (byte-level BPE with a separate merges file). If we import with the standard 'redwood-tokenizer' we'll see off-by-one BOS tokens in a few tests. Suggested config to add to model entry:```
{"tokenizer": "nebula-bpe", "tokenizer_files": ["vocab.json", "merges.txt"], "use_fast": false}
```
This avoids the broken prefixes we've been seeing.

maria.ops: thanks — will add that config. @sam.legal any blockers on the license side? Model card lists "CC BY-NC 4.0" and an attribution requirement. We need to know whether this can be hosted on Redwood API or limited to Dedicated/Private.

sam.legal: short answer: CC BY-NC is non-commercial. That generally prevents offering it as a public hosted endpoint (i.e., our multi-tenant hosted API). We can allow Dedicated + Private (customer-managed infra) if the customer accepts the license. Also we need the model card to explicitly state attribution text and provenance (author/origin). If weights are derived from any restricted checkpoints (eg. LLaMA derivatives) we need explicit permission — please confirm provenance.

raj.mlinfra: re: provenance — ingestion notes show source: huggingface.co/nebula/nebula-8b (community upload). No explicit derivation claims in the README. I'll ping the uploader for clarification if legal needs it. For immediate gating, should we mark this as "restricted-noncommercial" in the catalog? That will auto-block Hosted routes.

ingest-bot: automated checks complete — metadata present: model_card.md (yes), license field (cc-by-nc-4.0), tokenizer files (vocab.json, merges.txt) detected, weights checksum matches. Derived_checkpoint_check: UNKNOWN (no explicit statement in model_card).

lee.token: small QA note — our eval harness flagged a <1% tokenization mismatch on system prompts (mostly quote handling). Recommend running tokenization regression set: /tests/tokenization/nebula-8b/regression.jsonl before we promote. I can add the run to CI.

maria.ops: plan: 1) I'll add tokenizer config to the catalog and label the model restricted-noncommercial. 2) raj, can you open a quick ask to the uploader for provenance and post the reply here? 3) lee, please add the tokenization regression to the CI and @ingest-bot to record results. 4) sam, once we have provenance and the exact attribution text, we'll attach the model_card_url and license excerpt.

sam.legal: sounds good. Also include the exact attribution snippet in the model metadata (e.g., "Model: Nebula-8B — Author Name — CC BY-NC 4.0"). I'll review the uploader reply and confirm whether Dedicated/Private-only is sufficient or if we need further consent.

raj.mlinfra: created GH issue #5123 to ask uploader for provenance + explicit derivation statement. I'll paste replies here.

maria.ops: perfect — thanks everyone. tagging for visibility: :thumbsup:

lee.token: I'll queue the tokenization regression job and link results once done.

ingest-bot: CI job queued: tokenization-regress/nebula-8b (run 1). Will update thread with outcome.
